content.text:
Okay, dark and clean, looks like an app. Not a government form. Good.

- Biggest number first: **"86,492 ₪"**, under "הכי הרבה נשאר בזוג הזה". So this pair is the winner.
- What's the pair: **"פסגות · ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)"**. Psagot I've heard of. Yalin Lapidot, kind of.
- Right side says **"הפקדתם 70,000 ₪"**, "10,000 ₪ עכשיו ועוד 500 ₪ בחודש, 120 חודשים". 500 a month is basically my number. So that turns into about 86k in 10 years.
- "כמה כל בחירה משנה" has a lines thing. I just read the labels: account goes from "מיטב טרייד 63,507" up to "פסגות 86,492", that's "עד 22,985 ₪". Fund is only "עד 4,492 ₪".
- Bold line at the bottom: the account matters way more than the fund. Okay, so the account choice is the big deal, which I didn't know.
- Fund card: "דמי ניהול: 0% קבוע, 0% משתנה, 0.02% נאמן". Super low. No idea what "נאמן" is. "קרן מחקה". Is that the ETF thing? I guess.
- Fund list: Yalin is picked at "+0.37%". "אלטשולר שחם" is "‎-43 ₪". iShares is "‎-213 ₪". So tiny differences, whatever.
- Account list: Psagot 86,492 is #1. Under it there's "דמי משמרת ₪699", no clue what that is, and "עמלות קנייה ומכירה ₪356". Leumi is 83,396 and says "לא בחשבון מחיר אחר… לסטודנטים". Wait, I'm a student? But it's not counted, so I'm not going to work that out.
- That's the screen. I wasn't opening the little arrow.

**Voice message:**
"Okay so, I found this comparison thing, it actually looks decent, dark mode, all of it. I'm going with Psagot and the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 fund, the 4D one. Fairly sure. What decided it was the big number up top: 500 a month plus 10k turns into like 86k in ten years, and that pair was the top one. And the thing that shocked me is that the broker matters way more than the fund. Like, up to 23k difference between accounts, but only up to about 4.5k between funds. Meitav Trade was the worst at like 63k. Fund fees are basically zero, 0.02-something. Words I didn't get: 'דמי משמרת', where Psagot has 699 shekels of it, so that's still kind of a cost?? Also 'נאמן', and I'm still not 100% sure 'קרן מחקה' is the ETF thing. Leumi had something about a student price that isn't counted, and I didn't dig into it. I stopped once I got to the account list. That was enough."
